statement: For every finite word over the source-bound pattern (000,110,101), a finite path from the canonical seed under the unchanged PN/inverse-PN/NE/reader/NN grammar has a terminal first-window occurrence at the word-sum lattice point.
source_policy: One canonical fixed seed; successful exact-integer native packet transfers only; point readout F(phaseFrame.window[0].vertex), not arbitrary cache points or a new coordinate decoder
proposed_invariant: If the native M-plane has h=b0+b2=m, every C reference has h=m-1 or m+1 and every M reference has h=m. Every admitted successor preserves these bounds, including terminal E. At the canonical m=0 seed, F_y=1-h restricts every first-window point to y=0,1,2.
coverage: Both regular orientations and all four split components, all 24 ordered markings, retaining every admitted planar P/N chart and all of its native outgoing operations. Translation covariance and origin/permutation-independent availability give the local induction, not a depth cutoff.
source_context: research/strominger/four-progression-directions-v1.md motivates this test. No scientific outcome is imported: this probe freshly checks the stronger reference-height bounds needed for the Ramsey query.
acceptance: The all-path point bound excludes required query (3,3,0), which is in L_3. This rejects the exact single-seed/first-window strategy, not alternative families or representations.
falsifier: An admitted successor violates the declared reference-height bounds, or a finite native path under this policy realizes the excluded point.
boundary: No claim against all Marici source policies, translated seed families, other point representations or the governing Ramsey conjecture.
